decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle builds directly on the firm's map.apps expertise and is cheap to maintain, but it has not appeared on the website since 2018 and, like the dropped search extension F, it is likely to be folded into general search functionality.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile control component whose lessons the firm has likely already absorbed into its platform and mobile products, so the remaining resources are better used in core development.
The GIS software platform is the flagship that draws on the firm's deepest engineering knowledge, research and standards work, making it central to the firm's direction.

Mobile field data capture lies close to the firm's GIS competence, serves both public and private customers, and can be improved through the firm's own R&D, so keeping it is justified despite the lack of recent visibility.
